verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing claims automation of invoice approval and payments (brex-docs-7) and procurement approval flows (brex-docs-15). The Payments API supports sending ACH, wires and checks (brex-docs-12), so payment approval and sending exist at a high level. The evidence never describes configuring approval permissions for designated teammates or a one-click approve-and-send action. missing for 10: documented approver role/permission configuration for bill pay, one-click approve-and-send flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
